prompt: Create ONE landscape 3:2 illustration, 1536x1024, for Sentit Catalan classroom listening worksheets. Fine ink and soft watercolor on airy warm white paper, muted sage, ochre and charcoal, fading naturally to white around the outer edges, consistent with the supplied canonical model sheets. The sheets are identity/style references only: preserve exact faces, ages, hairstyles, skin tones and clothes; do not reproduce sheet layouts or labels. Natural engaged poses and hands. No readable writing, letters, numbers, captions, logos, speech bubbles or watermark. Clear composition at 80mm printed width. Contextual scene, not a posed portrait. Do not depict the solutions to comprehension questions. Only Mar, the adult female local news reporter in the attached model, with sage blazer, cream top and dark trousers. Scene: outside the FRONT of a small neighborhood bakery, Mar stands at a slight diagonal on the pavement, holding a small reporter's notebook with entirely blank pages and checking a small handheld microphone before making a local report. In the background a wide ordinary front display pane shows softly painted breads inside, beside a plain closed shop entrance; warm morning light. Focus on the reporter gathering local bakery news. Do NOT show a SIDE service window, transactions, shopping bags, queues, customers, name labels, clocks, posted schedules or ordering methods. No other people.
